stocks.reason: Shares surged ~55% after announcing positive Phase 3 topline results for DT120, an LSD-based oral treatment for major depressive disorder; met primary and all key secondary endpoints with 8.1-point MADRS improvement (p<0.0001)
AbbVie announced $10.9B all-cash acquisition at $135.11/share to deepen its immunology pipeline; Apogee stock surged ~46.7% on the buyout premium

Fell ~16.4% for its third consecutive session; MSCI assigned lowest possible CCC ESG rating, and Bloomberg reported SpaceX plans a $20B bond offering despite already raising $75B in IPO and announcing $60B Cursor acquisition — raising capital burn alarm

Stock dropped ~6% — worst day in a year — after reports that Nobel Prize-winning DeepMind researcher John Jumper is joining Anthropic and transformer co-author Noam Shazeer is moving to OpenAI, intensifying AI talent exodus concerns

Rose ~6-7% on pre-earnings momentum ahead of June 24 fiscal Q3 report; multiple analysts lifted targets to $1,500 (Cantor, Deutsche Bank) citing AI memory demand; EPS expected at $20.05 vs $1.91 a year ago

Shares jumped ~7% on dual analyst upgrades: JPMorgan to Overweight (PT $165 from $108) and Barclays to Overweight (PT $145 from $115), both citing automotive electronics outgrowth trajectory and reduced execution risk

Tumbled ~10% to new 52-week low as U.S.-Iran peace talks progress in Burgenstock, Switzerland erased geopolitical risk premium across defense sector; peers Lockheed (-4.9%) and RTX (-3.5%) also fell sharply

Fell ~9% as investors weighed $2.3B+ in cumulative insider selling since IPO lockup; CEO Michael Intrator sold $35.9M in shares last week under 10b5-1 plan; stock also began trading in Nasdaq-100 today after quarterly rebalance addition

Fell to 14th consecutive losing session — worst streak ever — down ~43% YTD near $152; Alphabet AI talent news dragged software complex lower; persistent fear that AI agents erode Salesforce's subscription model
ADR surged ~13-15% driven by Taiwan AI GDP boom forecasts and wafer price hike expectations; Intel collaboration reports added positive sentiment for the semiconductor foundry
